methodology.domain_eligibility: all ground-truth cards fully inside the fixed ROI and mean short-edge angle inside the constraint; negatives are eligible
methodology.execution: sequential, single caller thread, alternating detect and extract; no concurrent benchmark processes
methodology.percentiles: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(p*n)-1]; samples equally weighted across scenes
methodology.scope: decoded-frame CPU measurements on the reported host; handset capture, decoding, display, thermal behavior and sustained FPS require measurements on the target phone
methodology.speedup: ratio of median durations against default on exactly the same eligible scenes
timed_apis: extract (includes detection and RGB crop allocation)

baseline_comparison.description: frozen pre-change Full -> optimized Full, same68primary regressions
